notes.title: Patch 1.6 + Raid Map Pack DLC Release
notes.content:
[b]Hello Knights![/b]

[b]Patch 1.6[/b] brings fixes and improvements - mainly item drop tier selection for all raids, more items displayed on the victory screen, and new nightmares in T3 raids. There are also 11 new parts including unique weapons like powerful plasma bombs.

[b]Raid Map Pack[/b] - new DLC adds 5 new raids including an underground base, towns, and an oil field.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2995910

Full list of changes and additions is at the bottom of this post.

[b]What's next?[/b]
MKN will now be in the maintenance phase, so no new major updates are planned. I will be monitoring feedback for major bug reports and will try to fix them in small updates. You can also expect a few new parts in occasional content drops. Thank you for every single feedback and bug report so far - you helped me make this game better.

[b]The story doesn't end here.[/b]

[b]MKN2[/b] will be officially under development starting this coming Monday! Ethan and humanity's struggle will continue. I will be working hard to create a bigger and better sequel in every way possible. There are many new features I want to add such as melee weapons, loadout saving, and different leg types. The list is long. You can expect an update here as soon as the MKN2 store page is ready, hopefully by the end of the year.

If you would like to support my endeavor financially, please consider purchasing available DLCs; each purchase helps to increase my budget. Please feel free to let me know what you would like to see in the sequel. Many of the features in MKN came from community suggestions.

[b]And thank you again, you give me the energy to keep working with determination![/b]



[b]Raid Map Pack DLC[/b]
Added 5 new raid maps - all unlocked after mission 2

-Added item drop settings for raids - so after progressing in the main campaign you can choose item tier drops in all raids

notes.title: Dev Update #8
notes.content:
[b]Hello knights![/b]
I'm finalizing my work on [b]patch 1.6[/b] and the [b]Raid Map Pack DLC[/b] . There are a few new unique weapons and parts coming to the game in the free update.

[b]GEM-40 Artemis[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/cac7d4611ffdca76d5f83ce324968acb9c5bf8a1.png[/img]
A unique Tier 3 lock-on missile launcher. Projectiles aim for their targets and, when a hit is ensured, fire a chemical laser which causes an instantaneous explosion on the target.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/5d848f9f88b3a035d48584b61144150b91113b77.gif[/img]

[b]ALC-01 Havo[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/722da58317833b97390b19ed87a325169565e0a6.png[/img]
The first laser assault rifle, similar to ELC-01 Sunstorm and SR-01 Surya, causes instant explosions on the target, though with a much higher firing rate and precision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/60c1fbee7f003d8ace1c7ff06d34c6271856902d.gif[/img]

A lot of you asked for a nuke, but NATO is still hesitant to use them. However, there are new experimental weapons coming that will come close to it:

[b]NV-30 Lena[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/ac854e9eea0b31d0236bee7a386f321476d24ef1.png[/img]

This is a Tier 3 plasma bomb launcher. Fires projectiles with an experimental explosive warhead that creates a huge plasma ball on impact, dealing damage over a large area for a few seconds. The explosion is strong enough to damage your mech so watch out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/0f9f4c694d2a5cab1d13187816f1161dbfd2e98f.gif[/img]

[b]LPM-1 Aurora[/b]
This is a Tier 2 cruise missile version with the same plasma warhead.


There will also be a new Tier 3 torso, [b]MF-122 Eclipse[/b], that will come in a few variants including one with four built-in coaxial gatlings.

Thank you for your ongoing feedback and issue reports. I try to keep track of them. Patch 1.6 will include new fixes and improvements. The item list on the victory screen will now show up to 250 picked-up items on a scrolled list. Also, as mentioned, you will be able to choose any drop tier on any raid map.

If you are interested in getting the upcoming DLC with 5 new raid maps or would like to support me in my endeavor to create a better and bigger sequel, please consider adding it to your wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2995910

More news coming soon.

notes.title: Dev Update#7 Raid Map Pack DLC Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

Mecha Knights: Nightmare is getting a second DLC - the [b]Raid Map Pack[/b]. This pack will contain five completely new raid maps, including farm fields, oil fields, small towns, and an underground base! 

The DLC will be released along with a patch that includes improvements, fixes, and free new T3 parts.

notes.title: Operation Ascalon DLC and Patch 1.5 Release
notes.content:
[b]Hello Knights[/b]
[b]Operation Ascalon DLC[/b] and [b]Patch 1.5[/b] are here!

As with the base game I really hope you will have epic fun, as much I was passionate about create the DLC and improving the base game! Thank you for the continuing support and all the kind words from you; they really helped to keep me motivated.

The release doesnt mean end of the development. 

The game was tested for months before the release but I'm a solo developer so something could always slip through, please let me know if you find any issues.

I will be monitoring steam forums a lot and start working on fixes immidietly if something will be reported.

Please also feel free to leave feedback or suggestions, I would love to hear what you have to say.

I hope you will have epic fun, and hear from you about how many thousends Reds you have managed to eliminate!

Good luck stopping the Red Apocalypse!

notes.title: Operation Ascalon DLC and Patch 1.5 Overview
notes.content:
[b]Hello Knights![/b]
[b]Operation Ascalon DLC[/b] and [b]Patch 1.5[/b] launch this Friday.
Here is a list of new content and improvements that come with it!

[u][b]Operation Ascalon DLC Expansion content:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Action-packed mini-campaign of 7 new missions set after the events of the main game, focused on defeating the southern swarm attacking the Suez Canal.
[*] New Tier 3 parts:
[*] 55 New Mech Parts
[*] 42 New Weapons including Laser Cannons, Assault Rifles with attached grenade and rocket launchers, napalm grenades, Gatling guns, automatic howitzers, Beam Cannons, Flak Guns, Quad Cannons, and more
[*] 30 New Active and Passive Modules
[*] 15 New Equipment
[*] Multiple New Enemy Types and Red Structures
[*] Active Protection Systems
[*] 4 New Raid maps
[/list]

[u][b]Patch 1.5:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Airstrike and Missile strike Active Modules
[*] Overall performance optimization
[*] Max number of enemies in the field setting (up to 350). This setting affects both difficulty and performance.
[*] NIGHTMARE waves in raids; past wave 15, there is a chance of a group of mini-bosses spawning
[*] Mission difficulty settings
[*] Battlegroup Upgrades
[*] Allied Vehicles and Mechs Upgrades

[*] Minor Character Portraits
[*] Reworked some 3D models

[*] New passive and active modules

[*] Save backups folder
[*] Cloud Saves

As you can see, there are a lot of new features and improvements that should bring you more fun, whether you decide to get the DLC or not.
Have fun!

The DLC can be wishlisted here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500350

notes.title: DevUpdate #6
notes.content:
[b]Hello Knights![/b]

[b]Here are some more new features coming this Friday with Operation Ascalon and Patch 1.5:[/b]

Introducing a new type of energy weapons - [b]Laser cannons[/b] - they hit their target nearly instantly in a straight line, unlike kinetic weapons, and cause large explosions on impact. Check out the ELC-01LV_Sunstorm in action.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/2ac82187ffebc0d13e5f887463a86dcaab88e35f.gif[/img]

[b]Tier 3 Torsos[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/2df54a19647b172447263af4e3bfb8d3325561ee.png[/img]
I'm adding a variety of new torsos in Tier 3. These will feature special attributes such as built-in auto-repair systems, auxiliary boosters for increased boosting speed, coaxial guns, and an integrated Active Protection System that uses lasers to shoot down incoming large projectiles. 

You'll be able to have one or two APS integrated in the torso to protect the front and back of your mech, with an additional option to mount two more on your shoulder equipment slots to protect your sides.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/62cad2b48f7c7dd43f21bd83daabe46de95715e1.png[/img]

The campaign screen will now display a Reds Kill counter, showing the total number of reds you've eliminated. Now you'll know how many thousands of enemies you've obliterated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/0814808fa36d02d0aa738e590c42f131e781bf1a.png[/img]

Another new feature in the patch is the Loadout Screen, allowing you to get an overall view of your mech or share your loadout with friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/16e895cb89041385a8ccc78df1c0670fa446423c.png[/img]

And finally, for those who like to have more challenges during raids - NIGHTMARE waves will be a new feature. Past wave 15, there will be an increasing chance of a large number of powerful enemies attacking you, including mutated versions of existing bosses and mini-bosses. So, watch out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/85371ab490fc0d43ac8eaecdfbb262906c48621e.png[/img]

Tomorrow, I'll post a summary of the new content and features that the DLC and patch will bring to you on Friday!

You can wishlist the DLC here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500350

notes.title: Operation Ascalon DevUpdate #4
notes.content:
[b]Hello Mecha Knights![/b]

The Operation Ascalon DLC is in its final production stage, with new content being polished during the ongoing closed beta tests.

Meanwhile, here are some new additions coming for free with Patch 1.5 to the base game:

Your arsenal will now include powerful active modules - Airstrikes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/b6c7f40027b02d87253288f40d5d366ee2a77d7c.png[/img]

[b]B2 Thermobaric Bombs:[/b]
Drops heavy thermobaric bombs on a targeted area, causing devastating widespread effects on the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/79ffdfe6b338fc7c83e2212782703cb156575ba2.gif[/img]

[b]AC130 Support:[/b]
Calls a circling gunship that provides fire support with its powerful howitzer. Targets are acquired automatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/798e709efbb3894df7f23849ce0195ea576699b5.gif[/img]

[b]F35 Airstrike:[/b]
Multiple jets perform a single flyover on your position, engaging nearby enemies.

Using airstrikes requires no laser-type enemies to be present on the battlefield. Each use will incur a deduction from the money you earned during the mission. Stay strategic and make the most of these powerful tools in your battles.

Continuing with the improvements to the base game mentioned in previous Dev-updates:

[b]Backup Saves:[/b]
To enhance overall game data safety, save game files will be automatically backed up in a special folder.

[b]Hit Damage Display System Update:[/b]
The system will provide more accurate data, including the sum of point and area-of-effect damage done by weapons in a given moment.

[b]Missions and Raids Thumbnails:[/b]
Thumbnails will be added to missions and raids on the campaign screen for easier navigation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/d40da495edf6addc44459d2552741ba68bc910cb.png[/img]

The coming DLC can be wishlisted here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500350 🔥
 
More news coming very soon.

notes.title: Operation Ascalon DevUpdate #3
notes.content:
Hello!
As the development of Operation Ascalon approaches its final stages, I wanted to let players know that Mecha Knights patch 1.5 will include content and new features that won't be limited exclusively to those who purchase the new DLC.
New additions to Active Modules will include Missile strikes - you will be able to call in a missile strike with various warheads to help you get out of difficult situations, including cluster munitions effective against larger groups of enemies. Even deadlier active modules will be revealed soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/09a8abf59644b4bc4b11ec84311e33e2fca594f4.gif[/img]

Another quality-of-life feature coming to Mecha Knights in patch 1.5 is auto-sell. Parts and weapons that you’ve previously acquired will be automatically sold on the victory screen, if you’ve already reached the maximum possible storable amount. For example, the third duplicate of a weapon or the fifth duplicate of an active module will be sold automatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/9f969729e92a4dd6c74c8bc1f0834368a152529e.png[/img]

Continuing on from the battlegroup upgrades mentioned in the previous update, which included vehicle damage and armor changes, further upgrades are coming which will include:
-predrops: Supplies will be dropped ahead of time before each mission to help you survive
-Field Repairs: Allied units will slowly regenerate health points.
-IFF upgrade: The health points of allied units will be visible on the HUD. This will be useful to combine with new active modules that will repair some of your allies’ hp during larger battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/7ef4afba92b780c9efe200ed216d19dbb77ef46a.png[/img]

Weapon Tier 3 will bring powerful new additions to your arsenal.
-Theia Laser: A powerful long range beam cannon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/d8f3838ef5260b3a8cf406bd2794d9ca59f0aae1.gif[/img]

-Flak Guns: Rapid firing autocannons with proximity fuses, useful for hitting moving targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/785bed6aa0a3bf3cb60ce639f281329dabab8e21.png[/img]

The game has also recently been updated to support Steam Cloud Saves too, so your saves will persist even if you uninstall or play on a different machine.

The DLC can be wishlisted here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2500350/

More news coming soon.

notes.title: Operation Ascalon DevUpdate #2
notes.content:
Hello Knights! Besides working on the new DLC content, I’ve also spent a lot of time improving the base game too, as something of a thank you for all the support I’ve received since releasing the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/a4d901a3447a0a37037505e897a5092b25f9a6e6.png[/img]

Now as you might have guessed, I love large scale battles. To make the battles even bigger I’ve optimized a lot of the code responsible for the AI, and in the patch that arrives alongside the DLC, I’m introducing a new game setting that I'm really excited about - Enemy Limit. Altering this will allow you to increase the number of Reds you encounter on the battlefield, with the maximum possible number depending on your hardware. This will impact the overall difficulty (and fun).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/12f0a50b713cac42e33ceb1c4a31177fb4103d83.png[/img]

Another new feature that will be added to the base game will be Battlegroup Upgrades. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/ce325f8c071d25dc1fd635e671ce2685499c03e8.gif[/img]

You’re going to be able to upgrade the tanks and infantry fighting vehicles that join you in battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/6d3ecccf8c1e6d60d19010e2c7dc02ef20e7241d.png[/img]

Some of the weapons will be getting the reworked 3d models they deserve too. Here’s an example, the new model for the S90 Astra:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/f2e11d9935168337bf42aa19d53d5d60e5c615df.png[/img]

notes.title: Operation Ascalon DevUpdate #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/efb42ec947759201bbdc2f23f2c03942b3410fbd.png[/img]
The development of Operation Ascalon DLC is progressing smoothly and is on track for release later this year. Here are some of the new additions to the game.

The DLC introduces a new chapter to the game's story with 7 new missions and 4 new raids. Players will follow Ethan and the Echo team as they confront challenges and adversaries in a mission to save the allied forces at Suez Canal from a new Red swarm. Additionally, two new characters will join the team and aid them in their mission.

New mech customization options will be added, including:
[list]
[*]APS, an active protection system mounted on the mech's shoulders that shoots down incoming large projectiles. It recharges using the mech's battery. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/b1bf42de04909d019ad03cadb883856a173b46f7.gif[/img]

[*]New assault rifle with a mounted grenade launcher that can launch additional grenade projectiles with every few shots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/fad754e0c85a7154e9c352bdb0b06b0fd539c603.png[/img]

[*]A lot of new mech parts 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/f90d773413e8770be2c86c40c90ea33446c723a2.png[/img]
[/list]

The Reds will, will pose more diverse and challenging threats to players, including new enemy types and structures such as Hives that spawn enemies until destroyed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/de3f2d2dd7f25b626aa260a7851b3d2d44a04c5d.png[/img]

The DLC also comes with a free patch that improves the base game mechanics, including the ability to adjust difficulty levels before each mission.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35970703/58ab3e347b2b77ba3bd57f82c588b690388942f1.png[/img]

Thats only some of the new additions, stay tuned for further updates. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Mecha Knights: Nightmare | OPERATION ASCALON
notes.content:
Greetings, Mecha Knights! 

First of all, thank you so much for all your support and feedback. Your incredible response has enabled me to keep developing the game. 

I’m back, and with some exciting news! I have the pleasure of announcing that the game will be enhanced further with DLC: 

Mecha Knights: Nightmare | OPERATION ASCALON

A newly formed taskforce is sent to the Middle Eastern theatre of war to stop an imminent disaster. 
An enormous swarm of Reds is attacking the Suez Canal. Losing this vital area would endanger the entire African continent, and the clock is ticking. 
Echo Team will be sent on a dangerous mission deep behind enemy lines to give the Allied forces a fighting chance.

Included in the DLC:
-New missions centred around defeating the Southern swarm
-New higher-tier weapons
-New parts to increase customisation options for your mecha
-New equipment for greater build diversity

Along with the DLC, the base game will also get an update with improvements and fixes. 
The official release date has not been determined yet, but rest assured I will announce it as soon as it is decided. 

Thank you again, and stay tuned for further development updates!

notes.title: Post-Release Development Plans
notes.content:
Hello Mecha Knights!
First of all, thank you for the awesome reception Mecha Knights has received! This has made these last five years of development 200% worth it.

I'm carefully reading your feedback and plan to improve the game over a series of upcoming patches and updates.

The biggest priority will be to fix reported issues and implement some of the most requested features including, but not limited to:
-4K resolution support
-Inverted mouse control
-Binding of additional mouse buttons

To give you easier access to the gear, drop rates in Raid Missions will be increased.

I will also be adding more content too:
-New Raid maps - based on missions 4, 18 and 19
-Tier 2 single-fire mode assault rifle variants
-Tier 2 Variants of shoulder auto-turrets
I also heard you like huge explosions, so I will be adding a Thermobaric Mine Layer (Tier 2  shoulder unit)

Development will continue after these updates and I would love to hear more of your suggestions and ideas.

-Gin

notes.title: 30 Additional days
notes.content:
Hey Mecha Knights, just wanted to share some details with you, with the intention of being as clear as possible.

Working as a solo developer by night and having a day job at the same time, is tough.

Ultimately it boils down to this: I won't be able to ship the game as fast as I promised.

Recent intense round of beta testing performed by the awesome community has revealed a few areas where the game can still be further improved.

The release date is being moved to August 30th, so I have more time to implement that last batch of fixes and improvements.

This game is a labour of love.  I feel that this additional month will significantly benefit the overall experience.

I do apologise for further delaying the game but I hope you will understand that I only have the best intentions for this game and for your enjoyment of it.

Thank you for your awesome support - I wouldn't have been able to go on for these five years without it.

-Damian

notes.content:

Work on the game goes well, here are the main improvements I made during the last weeks:
-Fully implemented Mech designer – choose Head/Arms/Chest/LowerBody/Legs.
-Added lots of new mecha parts and weapons.
-Made a lot of progress on the campaign.
-Improved rendering - implemented better lighting, including volumetric lights.
-Improved level colliders, created a system that prevents from walking through walls.
-Improved blood effects.
-Improved overall performance, especially in natural environments.
-Fixed many errors – builds should be more stable now.
-Hangar menu now shows the difference between the stats of equipped and compared parts.
The list is much longer, those are the most important changes.
